numeric_semantics: complex amplitudes represented as pairs of Python Fraction values; irrational and trigonometric coefficients are deterministically rationalized by the qasm_matrix implementation, including 1/sqrt(2), so exact equality is exact only within that encoded rational model
notes: Canonical Python unitary profile. Source syntax requires a leading OPENQASM 3.0; header, exactly one terminated qubit[n] q; declaration, terminated executable statements, and indexed q[i] wire references. q[i] is basis-index bit weight 2^i (LSB). CZ and CP act on every matching basis state, including spectator-qubit states. Hadamard is normalized by the interpreter's deterministic rational approximation to 1/sqrt(2). Only syntactically recognized include "..."; lines are skipped, and they are not library-semantic imports. This profile is distinct from legacy unitary.v1 and does not reinterpret historical evidence.
